name: Undead Patron

source.note: Entered from the 2025 Unearthed Arcana (Horror Subclasses) and published reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A bargain with a lich, a vampire or another deathless power, which lends its terrible shape and its mastery of the threshold between life and death.

feature.name: Form of Dread
feature.summary: Bonus Action: transform for 1 minute (1d10 + Warlock level Temporary Hit Points, immune to Frightened, a hit can frighten once per turn). Charisma-modifier uses per Long Rest.
feature.text: Cost: a Bonus Action. Uses: Charisma modifier (at least 1) per Long Rest. For 1 minute (ending early if you're Incapacitated or choose to) you wear your patron's dread: you gain 1d10 + Warlock level Temporary Hit Points; you can't be Frightened; and once per turn an attack roll that hits can force a Wis save against your spell save DC, leaving the target Frightened through the end of your next turn on a failure.

feature.name: Undead Spells
feature.summary: Blindness/Deafness, False Life, Phantasmal Force and Ray of Sickness always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: Always prepared from the Warlock level shown: 3 Blindness/Deafness, False Life, Phantasmal Force, Ray of Sickness; 5 Speak with Dead, Vampiric Touch; 7 Death Ward, Phantasmal Killer; 9 Antilife Shell, Cloudkill.

feature.name: Grave Touched
feature.summary: Your Necrotic damage ignores Resistance; in Form of Dread, once per turn a damaging spell can deal Necrotic instead; no need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep.
feature.text: Arcane Necrosis: your spells' and attack rolls' Necrotic damage ignores Resistance to it; in Form of Dread, one damaging spell per turn can switch to Necrotic. Undead Endurance: no Exhaustion from thirst, hunger or suffocation; you never need sleep and magic can't make you sleep.

feature.name: Necrotic Husk
feature.summary: Resistance to Necrotic (Immunity in Form of Dread); once per Short Rest, dropping to 0 erupts in a 30-foot Necrotic blast and leaves you at 10 × Charisma modifier Hit Points.
feature.text: Necrotic Resilience: Resistance to Necrotic damage, upgraded to Immunity in Form of Dread. Unholy Resuscitation (once per Short or Long Rest): when you drop to 0 Hit Points and survive, you burst with grave energy; creatures you choose within 30 ft make a Con save against your spell save DC, taking 2d10 + Warlock level Necrotic (half on a pass). You then stand at ten times your Charisma modifier in Hit Points (10 at least) and gain an Exhaustion level.

feature.name: Superior Dread
feature.summary: In Form of Dread: fly at your Speed and hover, no components for Conjuration and Necromancy Warlock spells, and regain Charisma-modifier Hit Points when you deal Necrotic damage.
feature.text: In Form of Dread: you fly at your Speed and can hover; Conjuration and Necromancy Warlock spells need no Verbal, Somatic or Material components unless the material is used up or priced; and once per turn, dealing Necrotic damage heals you by your Charisma modifier (1 at least).
